Raj Patel: handing Olympus (mid-market fintech) to CS. $120k ARR, 20-seat pilot. Renewal 2026-10-15. On hosted API; considering Private/VPC later. Blockers: Okta SSO failures, embedding latency from eu-west-1 (~350ms p50, spikes), PII/KMS needs. Maria is primary. Please share contract PDF, Okta metadata, failing request ids.

Maria Torres: thanks — taking it. Plan: kickoff this week, SSO triage (Ana), perf tests (Lee), build enablement + prompts. Raj pls share contract + IdP metadata.

Raj Patel: shared links via DM. Contact: Priya Mehta (priya@olympus-fin.com). Pilot: chat + embeddings for compliance search; staging in eu-west-1. Example error 2026-03-18 14:02:12 req=0x8f3b — 401 assertion.

Ana Gomez: I’ll triage SSO. Need IdP XML, sample SAML assertion, affected user list. Can enable tenant SSO logs. ETA 24h.

Lee Chen: I’ll run isolated perf tests against eu-west-1. Request a sample payload or request id and sequence length distribution. Hypotheses: routing to larger model or KV cold starts; test quantized variant and smaller context window.

Maria Torres: attached redacted payload. Avg sequence ~420 tokens for embeddings. Kickoff with client Mon 10am PT.

Lee Chen: please run a staging curl to call model open-embed-1 and paste the reported latency; check for KV setup times and cache hit rates.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance: model-variant rollout eu-west-1 at 1940025000 UTC. Reply with :no_entry_sign: to request a freeze.

Maria Torres: Action items: Maria — kickoff Mon 10am PT and capture enablement material; Ana — SSO triage, findings in 24h; Lee — perf tests + model/quant recommendations by Thu EOD; Raj — confirm contract and Okta admin (done). I’ll create a Jira tracker and ping when created.

Raj Patel: :thumbsup: Priya is cc'd on the email thread; reach out if you need a warm intro.
